Who we are

An Egyptian charity working alongside the state for families who need it most

Volunteering for the common good is among the noblest work a person can do. It is a wellspring of giving that strengthens cooperation and solidarity, free of prejudice or partisanship and guided by human values and the tolerant teachings of faith.

  • Developing skills and people
  • Fighting poverty, advancing education
  • Empowering women and young people
  • Solidarity and lasting development
